t: A programmable Eurorack synth module you can turn into any sound effect.
steps: Buy the module from the Daisy store or a synth shop such as Detroit Modular.
Mount it in a Eurorack case with a power supply.
Connect it to a computer with a micro USB cable.
Open the Daisy web programmer in a browser.
Flash a patch_sm example such as the reverb from DaisyExamples.
Patch audio in and out and turn the knobs to hear the change.
Install VS Code and the GNU Arm tools or Arduino with DaisyDuino to write your own code.
meta: Wild Open. From $39.99. A few stores.
